compiled_state.title: migration-class-detect.sh import-line filter is dead code (cut -d: -f4- on 3-field sg output)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: Discovered during 2bd4 gap analysis. plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh excludes import lines before counting call sites by extracting content via 'cut -d: -f4-', but this sg version emits 'path:line:content' (3 colon-fields), so field 4+ is empty and the import-exclusion regex never matches. Currently harmless because the call-site pattern legacy_call($$$) does not match import statements, but the filter provides no actual protection and would silently fail to exclude an import that happened to match a future pattern. Fix: parse path:line:content (cut -d: -f3-) so the import filter operates on the real content field. Reported, not blocking 2bd4.

comments.body: Fixed by epic dso-uvyl deep-review remediation (merged to main, v1.17.117): migration-class-detect.sh import-line exclusion corrected from 'cut -d: -f4-' to '-f3-' (sg default output is file:line:content). Also removed the dead DETECTION_QUERY assignment and dead sym param in the same pass.
